WHY WE’RE BUILDING STATBATT

Clarity is the feature.

01

Know what a reading means

Estimates carry a ~. Unsupported readings say Unavailable. Missing measurements stay missing, including in exports.

02

Keep the story together

Seven days of local, one-minute charge, temperature, and net-power summaries, visible sleep gaps, CSV exports, and optional alerts live together in one app. Readings depend on availability.

03

Feel at home on your Mac

A native SwiftUI menu bar app with Battery, Charging, History, and Settings views. No cloud account is needed in the current build.

A CLEAR DEVELOPMENT BOUNDARY

Monitoring first.
Charging still in qualification.

StatBatt’s monitoring, history, exports, settings, and optional alerts are implemented locally. Its Apple 80% setting lab passed on one exact Mac and macOS target; end-to-end app, electrical cutoff, and lifecycle checks remain pending.

The limit persists after quitting. Confirmation and restoring 100% are manual. Custom charge bands, intentional discharge cutoffs, and temperature-based charging controls are unavailable.

Read the current development status

CHOOSE BY YOUR PRIORITIES

A good fit is personal.

Follow StatBatt if…

You want clear readings and local context.

Our focus is an integrated Mac experience: explicit estimates, honest missing values, seven-day history, CSV, and optional alerts. A public release is still ahead.

Consider coconutBattery if…

You want broader device diagnostics.

Mac, iPhone, and iPad battery insight, with saved health history. Plus adds lifetime analysis, advanced device and SSD details, custom printing, notifications, and Wi-Fi support. Official features ↗

Consider Energiza if…

You want more charging control today.

Energiza Pro documents configurable charge limits, immediate charge/discharge, automatic discharge, and thermal charge protection. Its monitoring and notifications are free. Official features ↗

SOURCES & METHOD

Make the comparison traceable.

This page compares documented features, not measured performance, accuracy, power use, or battery-life improvements. We have not run a live comparison of the vendor apps. Edition labels matter; features may depend on hardware and macOS. The native interface and local workflow are StatBatt design choices, not claims that competitor apps lack them.
